summary: The DGA button: a native button with the variant, size, destructive, on-colour, selected, loading and icon matrix. Use it for every action; the label is projected content, already translated.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Visual emphasis. One primary button per view.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: The native button type; use submit inside a form.

inputs.name: destructive
inputs.description: Error-toned styling for deleting or irreversible actions.

inputs.name: onColor
inputs.description: Styling for a dark or brand-coloured surface.

inputs.name: selected
inputs.description: Visual selected state, for the active item of a button group.

inputs.name: pressed
inputs.description: Toggle state rendered as aria-pressed; null is an ordinary button.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Disables the button, marks it aria-busy and shows a decorative spinner.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the native button; a disabled button emits no click.

inputs.name: iconOnly
inputs.description: Hides the projected label; requires label as the accessible name.

inputs.name: fullWidth
inputs.description: Stretches the button to the inline size of its container.

inputs.name: leadIcon
inputs.description: Decorative icon before the label (mirrors in RTL when the icon is directional).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name (translated); required with iconOnly, otherwise it overrides the projected label for assistive technology.

slots.description: The visible label (translated text, optionally with inline markup).

a11y: A native button element: Enter and Space activate it, focus shows the token focus ring. loading sets aria-busy and disables it; pressed renders aria-pressed for toggle buttons; label sets aria-label. Listen with (click) on <dga-button>: disabled and loading buttons emit no click. Icons are decorative and mirror in RTL through the icon manifest.
